### Your Identity Is Secure in Christ
Author: Alisha Headley
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/your-identity-is-secure-in-christ.html
Passage: 1 John 3:1
Points:
- Believers easily fall into the trap of tying self-worth to productivity, roles, or milestones.
- Unmet expectations and painful losses expose how fragile an achievement-based identity really is.
- God's lavish love is poured out unconditionally rather than earned through personal success.
- A Christian's identity is an unearned gift to be received, not something to be built.
- Resting in one's permanent belonging as God's child brings an unshakable peace.

### You Are Who God Says You Are
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-september-27-2019.html
Passage: 1 John 3:1
Points:
- Many believers remain trapped in feelings of inadequacy even after coming to faith in Christ.
- Living in defeat happens when Christians define themselves by past failures instead of their new standing.
- God lavishes His love on believers, declaring them to be His chosen, forgiven, and holy children.
- Spiritual freedom requires actively trusting God's Word above self-doubt and enemy accusations.
